- name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            after stripping.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner

All 31 tests pass and the build succeeds. The change is complete.

## Summary

I implemented the business-day rule for owner registration in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`:

1. **Compute the effective registration date up front** — the supplied `registrationDate` when present, otherwise the server date (`LocalDate.now()`) — then roll it forward with a new `toBusinessDay` helper (Saturday → +2 days, Sunday → +1 day, weekday unchanged).

2. **Daily create-limit now counts per adjusted business day** — the `countOwnersRegisteredOn` / `DailyOwnerLimitExceededException` check uses the adjusted `effectiveRegistrationDate` instead of raw `today`.

3. **The stored `registrationDate` is always the adjusted date** — replacing the old "default only when null" logic, so a supplied weekend date is now rolled forward too.

Because the membership number is derived from the stored `registrationDate` year (in `OwnerMapper.membershipNumber`), the year segment automatically uses the adjusted date — no mapper change needed.

The relevant new tests (`Cp07` weekend-rolls-to-Monday / weekday-kept, `Cp14` membership YY from adjusted date, `Cp20` default is always a business day) pass, and the full suite is green (31/31).
